headline: Senior full-stack engineer with architecture ownership
subheadline: I build and modernize product platforms across the frontend, backend, cloud, and infrastructure, balancing long-term technical decisions with pragmatic delivery.
lead: As a software architect and senior software engineer, I build and modernize business and product platforms with .NET, Angular and Azure. From Lucerne I work with teams across Switzerland and Europe, with a focus on systems that run both as SaaS and on-premises.
